# openwrt_uci_sections (Data Source)

Lists the sections of a UCI config in file order. Secret-looking options are withheld unless `include_sensitive` is set.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) Config file name.

### Optional

- `include_sensitive` (Boolean) Return secret-looking options in `sensitive_options`.
- `type` (String) Only sections of this type.

### Read-Only

- `sections` (Attributes List) The sections. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sections))

<a id="nestedatt--sections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sections`

Read-Only:

- `anonymous` (Boolean) Whether the section is anonymous.
- `index` (Number) Position in the config file.
- `lists` (Map of List of String) List options.
- `name` (String) Section name (generated for anonymous sections).
- `options` (Map of String) Scalar options, excluding secret-looking ones.
- `redacted_options` (List of String) Names of secret-looking options that were withheld.
- `sensitive_options` (Map of String, Sensitive) Secret-looking options; only populated with `include_sensitive = true`.
- `type` (String) Section type.
